name: rpg-table
description: Online D&D / tabletop RPG platform — rooms, roles, animated dice

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/restart-server.mts
scripts.up: concurrently -n server,tunnel -c cyan,magenta "npm start" "npm run online"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
